container: background-color: #0d120d; padding: 36px 12px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
card: background-color: #131a13; border: 1px solid #243524; border-radius: 0; padding: 22px 18px; margin: 0 0 30px
p: font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; color: #a8d8a0; margin: 0 0 16px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #00ff41; text-align: left; margin: 0 0 18px; letter-spacing: 1px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
h2_prefix_html: $
h3: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #a8d8a0; text-align: left; margin: 24px 0 12px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
h3_prefix_html: ##
blockquote: background-color: #0a0e0a; border-left: 2px solid #5a7a58; padding: 14px 16px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #5a7a58; font-size: 14px; text-align: left; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
pre: background-color: #080b08; border: 1px solid #243524; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; margin: 0 0 16px
code: color: #a8d8a0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #080b08; color: #00ff41; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 13px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
list_prefix_html: *
list_item: font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.8; color: #a8d8a0; margin: 0 0 8px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #080b08; color: #00ff41; font-weight: 700; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0; border: 1px solid #243524; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 13px
blockquote_prefix_html: >
footer: text-align: left; color: #00ff41; margin: 34px 0 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
